reason: The named independent lab and the batch report behind the QR code are what I usually have to hunt for, so at $24.99 I would try one box and check the report against the batch number myself.
objection: Why only bisglycinate when other brands put several magnesium forms in one capsule? Also it is made in China and there are no reviews yet, so I would want to see the report before trusting it.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR report did not match the batch number on the box, or the lab was not a real named lab I can look up, I would not buy.
